title: Prospective BNG3 source-law compatibility check for a linear birth-death SBML model
scope: One held-out BNG3 ensemble for the exact linear birth-death source class; this is not a general simulator correctness claim.

source_validation.validated_source_law: X(0)=100; independent particles have birth propensity X and death propensity 1.1*X; no events, rules, time-varying parameters, or packages alter these propensities.
source_validation.applicability_boundary: Exact subcritical linear birth-death transition only; b=1.0 < d=1.1; initial time is zero. Other propensities and nonzero start distributions are out of scope.

engine_run.git_ref_requirement: Dispatch on integrated main only, record its full commit SHA before scoring, and use the same SHA for package/native provenance.

independent_source_law.method: Exact equally spaced subcritical linear birth-death transition: binomial surviving ancestors plus a negative-binomial count of additional descendants.
independent_source_law.dependence: Each replicate preserves serial dependence across the complete trajectory.

decision.statistic: T = max over t=1..50 of abs(Z_t)/3 and abs(Y_t)/5, where Z=sqrt(n)*(sample_mean-exact_mean)/sqrt(exact_variance), Y=sqrt(n/2)*(S2/exact_variance-1), and S2 uses denominator n.
decision.multiplicity_control: One maximum statistic covers all 100 official mean/variance tests and their within-trajectory dependence.
decision.monte_carlo_p_value: (1 + number of independent source-law replicates with T >= held-out engine T)/(1000 + 1).
decision.uncertainty: Two-sided Wilson 95% interval for the source-law exceedance probability; report replicate count and every seed.

labels.PASS: Wilson interval lower bound exceeds alpha: this receipt is not rejected by this source-law diagnostic.
labels.FAIL: Wilson interval upper bound is below alpha: this receipt is inconsistent with the exact source law under this diagnostic.

decision.claim_boundary: These labels apply only to this held-out ensemble and this source-law statistic. They do not override official SBML Test Suite conformance or establish general simulator correctness.

historical_analysis_boundary: The cf93ba7c run used to develop this statistic is retrospective and must not be described as prospective qualification.
